description: Deterministic construction of a Knowledge Graph from a model that publishes its own metadata as an ISO/IEC 11179 registry stored with it. No LLM, no MCP, no guessing — the registry's object classes, data elements, value domains, permissible values and associations are walked directly into the two-layer topology; the deployed types come from the data dictionary.
_surface_legend: surface ∈ {deploy, edit, both}: 'deploy'=per-build only, 'edit'=template config only, 'both'=Edit sets default + Deploy overrides. 'none'=identity field, never user-editable.

profile_id.description: Profile that will own the knowledge graph (any KG-capable profile; no MCP tools required).

connection_id.description: Database connection holding the registry and the deployed model. Credentials are resolved through the platform's encrypted connection store — never entered here.

catalog_database.description: The database holding the five ISO/IEC 11179 registry tables. Discovered deterministically by scanning the connection's dictionary.

core_database.description: The database the model's entities deploy into — the graph's anchor and trusted scope. Leave empty to read it from the registry's deployed_object column.

model_name.description: Display name of the logical model root; every entity is qualified by it.

discovery_mode.description: Strategy selector — fixed for this template.

include_columns.description: Include attribute and column nodes, carrying each data element's definition, PII/sensitivity classification, declared vs deployed type and decoded permissible values. Off = a compact entity-level graph.

include_physical.description: Include the physical layer (schema/table/column) with real, queryable identifiers and types read from the data dictionary — views included. Required for the grounding gate's trusted scope to resolve.

max_value_codes.description: Cap on decoded permissible values kept per attribute, keeping node payloads bounded on large code lists.

validate_with_source.description: Probe the deployed objects (row counts, declared-key uniqueness, stored date shapes, blank ratios) and stamp the readings on the graph.

graph_name.description: Display name for the knowledge graph (defaults to the model name).

kg_store_config_id.description: Graph store backend to build into (defaults to the profile's configured backend).

logical_layer.description: The model's meaning — what an analyst reasons about.

physical_layer.description: The deployed, queryable realization — what SQL actually addresses (tables and views alike).

notes.type_rule: Meaning comes from the registry (declared_type); the deployed type comes from the data dictionary, which covers views as well as tables. A divergence is counted and reported, never silently reconciled.
notes.bridges: An association of kind type_correspondence is a declared CLASS-level correspondence between two domains, never an instance join. It becomes a product_bridge node stating its basis and whether both ends resolved — a governance finding when they do not.
notes.resync: The graph stores a source descriptor and can be re-synced when the registry changes.

structural.description: Deterministic read of the 11179 registry into the two-layer topology. Physical column types come from the data dictionary, never from the registry's declared type.

parsing_rules.database: The logical model itself (root node), stamped standard=iso_11179.
parsing_rules.domain: One per subject_area declared on the object classes.
parsing_rules.entity: One per object_class row: definition, natural key, grain, deployed object, temporal pattern, lineage.
parsing_rules.attribute: One per data_element row: definition, declared vs deployed type, PII/sensitivity, semantic type, decoded permissible values.
parsing_rules.schema_table_column: The deployed realization named by deployed_object; types read from DBC.ColumnsV (views included).
parsing_rules.implements: Physical table -> logical entity, physical column -> logical attribute.
parsing_rules.foreign_key: From association rows of kind pk_fk_join / bridge.
parsing_rules.is_a: From association rows of kind is_a (subtype -> supertype).
parsing_rules.product_bridge: From association rows of kind type_correspondence: a node carrying the basis, with relates_to edges to each end that resolved.
